title: I switched to Android after more than a decade on iPhone and I'm not going back. Here's why (AAPL, GOOG, GOOGL)
text: I switched to Android after more than a decade on iPhone and I'm not going back. Here's why (AAPL, GOOG, GOOGL) By Harrison Jacobs Nov 26, 2018, 4:43 pm 27 pts I've been a diehard Apple user for as long as I can remember, and I've exclusively used iPhones since I got the original shortly after it came out in 2007. When it came time to retire my iPhone 6S this year, I was frustrated by the high price of Apple's newest phones, the XS and the XR. After…
